note: Curated waypoint descriptions, keyed by the stable ids in data/waypoint-ids.json. Applied by scripts/build-trails.ts (overriding any description from the GPX source) and uploadable to the comments API with scripts/upload-descriptions.ts. Listed north to south, from Ramsay Bay to George Point, matching the km order of the generated trail data. Facilities (toilets, platforms) are left out until a Queensland Parks page can be read in full. Temporary closures are dated ('As of October 2026') so they can be found and removed. Sources for each fact: plans/waypoint-description-sources.md.

descriptions.name: Nina Bay
descriptions.description: Camping area on the white sand of Nina Bay, the bay after the Ramsay Bay start and before Little Ramsay Bay. Water is in the creeks at each end of the bay, 100–200 m upstream.

descriptions.name: Little Ramsay Bay campsite
descriptions.description: Camping area on the south side of the lagoon at Little Ramsay Bay, reached from Nina Bay by rock-hopping around the headland. The water sources listed for this stretch are the Nina Bay creeks and the lagoon at Blacksand Beach.

descriptions.name: Banksia Bay campsite
descriptions.description: Small, quieter camping area on Banksia Bay, on the stretch between Little Ramsay Bay and Zoe Bay. Water is in Banksia Creek, about 100 m upstream from the beach.

descriptions.name: Zoe Bay campsite
descriptions.description: Camping area at South Zoe Bay, about half a kilometre from Zoe Falls. Water is in Zoe Creek, about 600 m upstream of the camp sites.

descriptions.name: Zoe Falls
descriptions.description: Waterfall about half a kilometre from the South Zoe Bay camping area, with a rock pool at its top that looks out over Zoe Bay.

descriptions.name: Thorsborne Trail High point
descriptions.description: Saddle of bare granite at 260 m above sea level, the highest point on the trail, reached from Zoe Bay along South Zoe Creek and then up a spur. On a clear day the Palm Islands and Magnetic Island are in view.

descriptions.name: Mulligan Falls campsite
descriptions.description: Camping area at the foot of Mulligan Falls, the one camping area with a one-night limit. The area beyond the falls is restricted access. The falls are the last reliable water on the trail before George Point.

descriptions.name: George Point campsite
descriptions.description: The southern end of the trail, at the end of a 5 km beach along Mulligan Bay, where boats from Lucinda (Dungeness) drop off and collect walkers. There is no reliable water between Mulligan Falls and here. As of October 2026 Queensland Parks report that erosion has removed the camping area's toilet and signs, so nothing marks the pickup point; walkers can bush camp under trees about 2.6 km south of the Mulligan Creek crossing, 250 m short of the pickup point, with no toilet.
